summary: Verified the mumzo logo clipping bug fix on the live React site + standalone HTML + regenerated static PNG/JPG assets. Nav + footer wordmark SVGs on the React site render viewBox=0 0 260 64 with 'mumzo' fully visible ('o' intact). Regenerated /logos/mumzo-insta-square.{png,jpg} and /logos/mumzo-wordmark-transparent.{png,jpg} all return 200 and show the complete wordmark with no right-edge clipping. Waitlist form regression pass: form submitted successfully with unique Hyderabad phone (500034 pincode), success card uses the mark-only variant (viewBox 0 0 64 64, no wordmark text) as expected, backend POST /api/waitlist returned 200 (counter incremented to 27). One minor deviation from the stated fix: standalone HTML nav SVG viewBox is still 0 0 240 64 (not updated to 0 0 260 64) - however visually 'mumzo' is NOT clipped there because the italic text bbox ends at x=172, still within the 240 unit viewBox.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified. Nav + footer wordmark on React site render at viewBox 0 0 260 64 with text 'mumzo' bbox width=110/112 starting at x=62 -> ends within safe margin. Static logo assets all 200 OK. Only nit: standalone HTML nav SVG line 234 still declares viewBox '0 0 240 64' — not visually clipped but not matching the stated fix. Waitlist form working end-to-end.
rca of the issue: Original bug: italic 'o' was clipped because SVG viewBox width (240) was too narrow relative to italic serif text width + lean. Fix: expanded viewBox to 260 (React + mumzo-logo.svg + standalone footer) and 280 (render-insta/render-transparent templates), then re-rasterized PNG/JPG assets. Verified via bounding-box inspection: text.getBBox() width ~= 110 starting at x=62, so max x ~= 172 which is comfortably inside the new 260 unit viewBox; also comfortably inside the still-240 standalone nav viewBox (which is why the standalone nav does not show a visual regression despite not being updated).
